fact.object: Claude Managed Agents 多智能体编排

evidence.quote: Anthropic is adding dynamic workflows to its Claude Managed Agents, bringing multi-agent orchestration to the platform. The managed agent infrastructure has been around for a while, but dynamic workflows are new. A lead agent creates a plan, distributes tasks to sub-agents,

Up to 1,000 agents can run in parallel per execution. Whether this is cost-effective seems debatable. A senior OpenAI engineer recently called agent swarms a massive waste of tokens , but Anthropic points to its own testing: The team hid 70 bugs in a 116,000-line codeba

title: Anthropic's Claude can now orchestrate up to 1,000 AI agents in parallel through dynamic workflows
summary: The Decoder 报道，Anthropic 为 Claude Managed Agents 增加动态工作流，主代理可规划并分配任务，单次执行最多并行 1000 个子代理；70 个隐藏缺陷的发现率来自 Anthropic 测试，成本效益仍待用户负载验证。
investorNote: 多代理编排有望提高复杂任务覆盖率，但需要用完成率、令牌消耗和人工复核一起衡量。
displayTitle: Claude Managed Agents 加入动态工作流，可并行调度子代理
narrative: Anthropic 给 Claude Managed Agents 加入动态工作流，由主代理拆分任务并汇总结果，报道所述上限为单次并行 1000 个子代理。Anthropic 的代码缺陷测试显示覆盖率提高，但报道同时提醒令牌消耗可观。投资上应把完成率提升与算力成本放在一张表里，避免把并行规模当作产品价值。
